title: Reproduce USA shop recording verification rejection
platforms: Windows GNU under Wine, Xvfb and Vulkan llvmpipe
changes: Record a real USA shop category change in an isolated application session and run the existing recording verifier.
validation: The GUI changed from headgear to armor; the complete 407-frame recording contains mouse:1025 and the actual debug-record verify exited 1 with mouse target out of range. ROM, source save, snapshot and executable hashes unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic XTest movement and click were combined; hover versus click was not isolated. No native Windows, Android or successful replay. First GUI script encountered EOF and its incomplete session was retained.
Managed cleanup rejects U31 units; both successful and incomplete session evidence remains isolated.
